item: Vertical-rail tab detail string: '<project> \u2387 <branch>' for a linked worktree whose current branch differs from the default branch (upstream sessionTabDetail).
reason: The helper requires three facts the live rail producer does not have: current branch, default branch, and a worktree flag. No CLI producer or server route exposes any of them; the rail detail is fed from the session directory basename alone.

helper_ready_but_starved.signature: session_tab_detail(project: &str, current: Option<&str>, default_branch: Option<&str>, worktree: bool) -> String

live_rail_producer.note: rail_inputs_for_navigation(5406-5416) sets detail = navigation.project_label(&tab.session).unwrap_or_default() - project only; current/default_branch/worktree are never supplied

live_project_label_source.note: session_directory_label: only std::path::Path::file_name() of the directory; never inspects VCS

model_lacks_fields.note: Tab (202-214) has session/parent/project_label/draft/cursor/scroll/selected_model only - no branch, no default branch, no worktree flag; project_label doc-comment explicitly: 'Named projects and VCS metadata are not inferred from this value.'

missing_seam.producer_required: A live VCS/location producer: the CLI must learn, per session location, the current branch, the repository default branch, and whether the checkout is a linked worktree. None exists.
missing_seam.server_route_absent: crates/server/src/lib.rs route table (189-302) has NO /api/location, NO vcs, NO branch-info route. grep for current_branch|default_branch|WorktreeInfo|vcs_status|git branch across crates/ returns matches in native_tab_rail.rs only (the starved helper doc, not a producer).
missing_seam.cli_route_absent: grep for /api/location|syncInfo|vcs.sync|current_branch across crates/cli/src returns 0 matches.

upstream_helper.quote: export function sessionTabDetail(project, current, defaultBranch, worktree) { const branch = worktree && current !== defaultBranch ? current : undefined; return branch && project ? `${project} \u2387 ${branch}` : (branch ?? project) }

missing_seam.consequences: session_tab_detail cannot be wired without inventing branch/worktree facts. A new server VCS/location projection (or a CLI git-read of the session directory, which has no authorization/caching seam yet) is required first. Wiring it with fabricated defaults would print a wrong branch.

focused_test_plan_when_unblocked: server/client: sync a location and assert current branch + default branch + worktree flag are exposed for a linked worktree
cli: linked worktree on a non-default branch renders 'proj \u2387 feat'; same branch as default renders 'proj'; non-worktree renders 'proj'
cli rail render: compact tooltip detail equals session_tab_detail output at the painted title budget
